name: Battle Traits: Idoneth Deepkin
abilities:
Concealing Tide: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other Tidal abilities this round. For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Idoneth Deepkin units that did not use any Charge abilities in the same turn.
Keywords: Tidal
Swift Tide: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you used the 'Concealing Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other Tidal abilities this round. For the rest of the battle round, friendly Idoneth Deepkin units can use Run abilities and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.
Keywords: Tidal
Sea's Embrace: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you used the 'Swift Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other Tidal abilities this round. Friendly Idoneth Deepkin units have Strike-first for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Tidal
Unpredictable Tide: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other Tidal abilities this round. Pick a friendly Idoneth Deepkin unit that is not in combat to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
Keywords: Tidal
Inexorable Tide: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you used the 'Unpredictable Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other Tidal abilities this round. Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly Idoneth Deepkin units for the rest of the battle round.
Keywords: Tidal
Storm's Wrath: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you used the 'Inexorable Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other Tidal abilities this round. Friendly Idoneth Deepkin units' melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Tidal
Twin Tides: Once Per Turn(Army), Reaction: You declared an Attack ability for a friendly Akhelian unit Pick a visible friendly Namarti unit that has not used an Attack ability this phase to be the target.
• If this unit used a Shoot ability, immediately after the Shoot ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase.
• If this unit used a Fight ability, immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a Fight ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit's attacks.

name: Akhelian King

weapons.name: Deepmare's Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities:
Wave Rider: Any Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Akhelian Royal Weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
Crest of the Wave: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly Idoneth Deepkin units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.

name: Akhelian Thrallmaster
abilities:
Thrallmaster: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit Pick a friendly Namarti Thralls unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.
Akhelian Insights: Any Combat Phase Melee weapons used by friendly Namarti units have Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea
abilities:
Dormant Energies: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
Tranquillity of the Abyss: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly Idoneth Deepkin units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Vengeful Waves: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Rampage
Tsunami of Terror: Your Hero Phase Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.
Keywords: Spell

name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm

weapons.name: Spear of Repressed Fury and Crulhook

abilities:
Drench With Hate: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Idoneth Deepkin units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Crashing Upon the Foe: This unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Retreat ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by Retreat abilities.
Pulled Into the Depths: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Rampage

name: Isharann Soulrender
abilities:
Lurelight: End of Any Turn Pick up to 3 different friendly Namarti units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn. Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.
Hangman's Knot: Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

name: Isharann Soulscryer
abilities: Finder of Ways: Reaction: You declared the 'Unpredictable Tide' ability or the 'Steed of Tides' ability Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.

name: Isharann Tidecaster
abilities:
Master of the Ethersea: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
*Creeping Mist:* Friendly Idoneth Deepkin units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.
*Surging Stream:* Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly Idoneth Deepkin units.
*Spiteful Riptide:* Each time an enemy unit uses a Retreat ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers
abilities:
Fount of Willpower: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a Spell ability for a friendly Isharann unit wholly within 12" of this unit Remove 1 of this unit's soul-quota tokens. Then, you can re-roll the casting roll.
Catalogue of Souls: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a soul-quota token.
Empowered by Memory: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible friendly Idoneth Deepkin unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. The target's melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Spell

name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep

weapons.name: Uasall's Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities:
First Among Akhelians: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly Akhelian units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Cealith, the High King's Shield: This unit has Ward (3+) against mortal damage inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities or abilities used by Manifestations.
Supreme Lord of Tides: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase Pick up to 3 other friendly Idoneth Deepkin units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

name: Akhelian Allopex
abilities:
Bloodthirsty Predators: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Allopex's Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.
Ensnared: Any Shooting Phase Pick an enemy Monster or Cavalry unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

name: Akhelian Ishlaen Guard
abilities:
Biovoltaic Barrier: Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit's weapons for the rest of the turn.
Galv-shields: This unit has Ward (5+) if it charged in the same turn.

name: Akhelian Leviadon

weapons.name: Leviadon's Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws

abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Leviadon's Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws is 5.
Crushing Charge: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy Infantry unit within 1" of it to be the target. Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Keywords: Rampage
Void Drum: Friendly Idoneth Deepkin units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

name: Akhelian Morrsarr Guard
abilities: Biovoltaic Blast: Any Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

name: Namarti Reavers
abilities: Strike On the Move: This unit can use Shoot abilities even if it used a Run or Retreat ability in the same turn.

name: Namarti Thralls
abilities: Sweeping Blows: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that Fight ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

name: Gloomtide Shipwreck
abilities:
Rise from the Depths: Deployment Phase This ability must be used instead of the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.
If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.
Keywords: Deploy Terrain
Guardians of the Deep: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Idoneth Deepkin Infantry and Cavalry units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.
Phantasmal Ruin: Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.
Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

name: Cyreni's Razors
abilities:
Phase Ink: Any Combat Phase If this unit's Cephanyr is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Cyreni of the Abyss: While this unit's Cyreni of the Abyss is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).

name: Elathain's Soulraid
abilities:
Elathain's Lurelight: End of Any Turn Roll a D3. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to this unit equal to the roll.
Soulnet: Any Combat Phase If this unit's Elathain Ill-fated is on the battlefield, pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

name: Akhelian Thrallmaster (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:
Raider Captain: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase Pick this unit and up to 3 friendly Namarti Thralls units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. Each target can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
Way of the Vortex: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit and friendly Namarti units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

name: Namarti Thralls (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:
Hit-and-Run Tactics: Any Combat Phase If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit's attacks. Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
Keywords: Core, Fight, Attack

name: Ikon of the Sea
abilities:
The Surging Sea: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Idoneth Deepkin unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.
Rapid Approach: This unit can use a Run ability and still use Charge abilities later in the turn

name: Ikon of the Storm
abilities:
Storm of Blades: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase This unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Whirlpool's Fury: Enemy units cannot use Retreat abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
Friendly units that use a Retreat ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.
No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly Idoneth Deepkin units by Retreat abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

name: Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss
abilities:
Siren Song of The Abyss: Any Combat Phase Pick up to 3 friendly Idoneth Deepkin units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' Companion weapons.
Crushing Pressure: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Keywords: Spell

name: Anvil of Apotheosis: Idoneth Deepkin Hero
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Sea-beast's Jaws is 3.
Bloodthirsty Predators: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Allopex's Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.
Swift as the Great Current: Any Combat Phase Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit is Infantry. On a 4+, this unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.
Prodigy of the Asydrazor: If this unit is Akhelian, add a number equal to the number of ranks this unit has earned on its Path to the Attacks characteristic of its Thalassic Weapon.
*For example, if this unit has earned the Legendary rank on its Path, add 4 to the Attacks characteristic of its Thalassic Weapon.*
Royal Lineage: Add 1 to the control scores of friendly Idoneth Deepkin units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Prodigy of the Túrscoll: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a Spell ability for this unit If this unit is Isharann, re-roll 1 of the dice in the casting roll.
Isolationist: This unit cannot be set up within 9" of any friendly units. In addition, friendly units cannot be set up within 9" of this unit.
Overly Cautious: Each time this unit is targeted by an attack, if you have any command points and a friendly unit has not already used the 'All-out Defence' command this phase, this unit must use the 'All-out Defence' command.
Legacy of Slaanesh: End of Any Turn This unit must use this ability at the end of each turn. Roll a dice. On a 4+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (a ward roll cannot be made for that damage point).
Pride and Arrogance: While this unit is in combat with any enemy Heroes, all of its combat attacks must target an enemy Hero.
Mighty Biovoltaic Blast: Any Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Clamping Bite: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy Monster within 1" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, on a 6, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Rampage
Deep-sea Aid: You can reroll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 save roll, 1 casting roll, or 1 unbinding roll for this unit. After you have done so, remove this unit's Sea-beast Familiar from the battlefield.
Sea-beast Familiar: This unit's Sea-beast Familiar is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the 'Deep-sea Aid' ability.
Abyssal Cephalopod: This unit's Abyssal Cephalopod is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the 'Pelagic Defender' ability.
Pelagic Defender: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll 8 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.
After resolving either effect, remove this unit's Abyssal Cephalopod from the battlefield.

name: Isharann Tidecaster (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Master of the Ethersea: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a visible friendly Idoneth Deepkin unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If the target is Namarti, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.
*Torrent of Blows*: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. That weapon has Crit (2 Hits).
*Protection of the Waves*: While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have Ward (5+).
*Frenzy of the Ethersea*: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that friendly unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

name: Namarti Reavers (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Merciless Hunters: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for
this unit After that Shoot ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
